alcaraz_matches_2024.question: How many matches did Carlos Alcaraz play in 2024?
alcaraz_matches_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON (m.player1_id = p.player_id OR m.player2_id = p.player_id) WHERE p.first_name = 'Carlos' AND p.last_name = 'Alcaraz' AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

italian_players.question: How many players in the database are from Italy?
italian_players.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE nationality = 'ITA' LIMIT 1000

djokovic_clay_wins.question: How many matches did Novak Djokovic win on clay between 2023 and 2025?
djokovic_clay_wins.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Novak' AND p.last_name = 'Djokovic' AND LOWER(t.surface) = 'clay' AND m.match_date >= '2023-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000
